gloss: indoor shoes; shoes worn inside a building

definitions.explanation: Shoes kept for wearing inside a school, hospital, or workplace, changed into at the entrance so that outdoor dirt is not tracked in.

examples.japanese: {内履|うちば}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{履|は}き{替|か}える→履き替える：06680_hakikaeru⟧。
{内履|うちば}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忘|わす}れて→忘れる：00474_wasureru⟧、⟦{靴下|くつした}→靴下：00726_kutsushita⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{廊下|ろうか}→廊下：05005_rouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{歩|ある}いた→歩く：00538_aruku⟧。
examples.english: I forgot my indoor shoes and walked down the hallway in just my socks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育館|たいいくかん}→体育館：03111_taiikukan⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{外履|そとば}き→外履き：27460_sotobaki⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧{内履|うちば}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: In the gymnasium, please use indoor shoes rather than outdoor shoes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、{内履|うちば}き⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{体操着|たいそうぎ}→体操着：24194_taisougi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{言|い}われた→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: As part of getting ready for the new school year, we were told to write our names on the indoor shoes and the gym clothes.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{内|うち}→内：01328_uchi⟧ (inside) + ⟦{履|は}き→履く：00700_haku⟧ (footwear). Most often heard in schools, where changing shoes at the entrance is standard practice. The near-synonym ⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧ is the more common word nationwide; {内履|うちば}き is used especially in contrast with ⟦{外履|そとば}き→外履き：27460_sotobaki⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {内履|うちば}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{履|は}き{替|か}える→履き替える：06680_hakikaeru⟧: to change into indoor shoes
- {内履|うちば}き⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧: to bring one's indoor shoes
- {内履|うちば}き⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧: shoes meant for indoor use

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{上履|うわば}き→上履き：10240_uwabaki⟧: indoor shoes — the standard school term, usually white slip-ons
- ⟦{外履|そとば}き→外履き：27460_sotobaki⟧: outdoor shoes — the direct contrast
- ⟦スリッパ→スリッパ：04531_surippa⟧: slippers — provided for visitors at offices, homes, and clinics
